reply.observation: The robot moved the rust mat onto the raised shelf. The person then pointed at the mat and toward the tabletop. The teal mat stayed in place.
reply.interpretation: The gesture may have been a request to put the rust mat back. It did not clearly identify the teal mat as the one to shelve.
reply.title: Check which mat should stay
reply.note: For this workbench, the number of parts on a mat may be a poor guide to which mat the person wants within reach.
reply.question: Should I put the rust mat back and shelve the teal one instead?
